claims.title: Dissipation-sensitive nonlinear sectors, resonances and remaining three-dimensional control

quoted_fields.interface: Ordinary additive physical Navier-Stokes forcing on the unit three-torus, fixed rational trigonometric actuators, full stretching retained. Each reusable unit has its unchanged specific linear/inviscid/viscous/fixed-fibre/planar/small-basin or invariant-family hypotheses. The common force must ultimately work for all unknown initial states, admitted disturbances and weak realizations, ending with small TOTAL velocity. Earlier extra-advection theorems use different equations.
quoted_fields.failure: Full common-force/all-H1/all-Leray-Hopf compiler remains OPEN, with no negative over all finite actuator families. Fixed noncritical coupled decay is not uniform over a growing set of modes. Critical anomalous/kernel transfer, background removal/approximation and genuinely3D nonlinear transient/inter-sector control remain open. The whole k_i=0 viscous echo is distinct from critical p=+/-1,l=0 Rayleigh modes. Smooth planar nonlinear echoes require their derivative bounds and zero transverse disturbance. All-weak return presently has an exponentially small basin. The selected quadratic small-impulse defect and high-impulse suppression concern one inviscid coefficient, not the full bilinear operator/higher iterates. Restricted invariant-family obstructions and fixed Galerkin volume bounds are not general PDE no-go results. The finite H1-net certificate is sound for passing witnesses but accepting-witness existence/total compiler termination is unproved. Physical Jacobi O(m^-2) bonds do not inherit the extra-advection first-weighted-moment dispersion theorem. All original proof bytes and prior unit versions remain preserved. Scalar theorem permits arbitrary L2 vertical preparations but only E-planar unknowns and E-planar plus vertical disturbances; no off-sector 3D noise or low-E suppression is provided. The inviscid resonant asymptotic concerns a DIFFERENT pair from A873, so both results stand. Its 2<q<3 compatibility window is not necessary scaling for the viscous full problem. Whole viscous mixed coefficient control is not all pairs/higher iterates. The planar quotient controls high modes only, has ordinary rather than enhanced decay, and supplies no low-mode contraction. Three-dimensional vortex stretching has no bound in that quotient; no 3D weak enstrophy identity is used. The all-weak energy envelope is algebraic but not small.
